title: Red Bean Paste Buns
description: Soft and fluffy buns filled with sweet red bean paste, a classic Chinese dessert.
instructions: Combine warm water, sugar, and yeast in a bowl. Let it sit for 5 minutes.
Add flour, salt, and butter to the bowl. Mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover it with plastic wrap, and let it rise in a warm place for 1 hour.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces. Roll each piece into a ball and then flatten it slightly.
Place a tablespoon of red bean paste in the center of each dough piece. Fold the dough over the filling and seal it tightly.
Place the buns on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Brush the tops with egg wash.
Bake the buns for 18-20 minutes, or until they are golden brown.
Let the buns cool on a wire rack for 5 minutes before serving.
